text.headline: Timeline of Venezuela
text.text: Major events in the history of Venezuela.

events.headline: Columbus Visits
events.text: Christopher Columbus lands on the coast during his third voyage.

events.headline: Spanish Colonization
events.text: Spain establishes settlements and colonizes the region.

events.headline: Declaration of Independence
events.text: First South American colony to declare independence from Spain.

events.headline: Battle of Carabobo
events.text: Simón Bolívar secures independence with a decisive victory.

events.headline: Republic of Venezuela
events.text: Separates from Gran Colombia as an independent republic.

events.headline: Gómez Dictatorship
events.text: Juan Vicente Gómez establishes authoritarian rule and modernizes oil.

events.headline: Democracy Restored
events.text: After Pérez Jiménez falls, democracy returns.

events.headline: Bolivarian Republic
events.text: Hugo Chávez introduces a new socialist constitution.

events.headline: Maduro Presidency
events.text: Nicolás Maduro succeeds Chávez amid crisis.

events.headline: Crisis & Negotiations
events.text: Economic turmoil continues with opposition talks.
